plan.goal: Perform a spatial join to count points from pa_data_epsg4326 that are contained within each county in pacounties, appending the count to the county attributes.
plan.notes: Handle CRS difference between EPSG:4269 and EPSG:4326. Use 'within' predicate for point-in-polygon spatial relationship. Aggregate to produce a single count per county feature and add it as a new attribute column.

plan.goal: Filter the county layer to retain only those counties where the attached point count is strictly less than 10.
plan.notes: Apply an attribute query on the point count field generated in step_01. Selection condition: count < 10. Preserve all original county attributes and geometry.
